symptom: Outcome Ledger 0.1 accepted year-0000 and RFC3339 -00:00 unknown-offset settledAt values that K1 and Forward Vault reject; the outcome schema date-time format alone does not exclude unknown offsets.
lesson: An ISO-shaped timestamp and finite Date.parse value do not establish a known-offset, cross-ledger-compatible settlement instant. A -00:00 offset explicitly denotes unknown local offset, and year 0000 is rejected by the current canonical validator compatibility policy.
guardrail: Reuse the K1/Forward Vault exact-instant guard at the Outcome Ledger boundary: reject year 0000 and -00:00 before digest/append admission, enforce the same conservative lexical boundary for schema-only consumers, and regression-test positive Z/+00:00/real offsets. Do not infer official settlement finality or ROI readiness from timestamp syntax.
